title: Setlist Metric3 High Value Outliers
dataSources: Practice sessions (`practice:session`), DAW sessions (`daw:session`), release/streaming stats (`release:stats`), gig setlists (`setlist:play`).
app: Music and creator telemetry — practice-tracker apps (Modacity), DAW project logs, and streaming/creator analytics (Spotify for Artists, YouTube Studio) — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=setlist:metric3 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in setlist metric3 (3) events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme setlist metric3 (3) records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It rates the unusually high or low value moments in your setlist metric3 (3) history.
